posts.t: Price reacted to this area because it was RBR (demand zone) after all. But we can't be certain that there was engulf into the pole without details. Deepest part of retrace is all what matters when it comes to engulf. So I wouldn't mark FL anywhere. This candle was very long so I suspect that price reversed somewhere around where upper wick begins but you can't be 100% certain unless you watched tick chart when this M1 candle was forming.
